files.description: Website clicks (500 rows): click_ref (seven-digit reference with leading zeros, e.g. "0000011"), epoch_s (Unix timestamp in seconds, UTC, whole number), epoch_ms (Unix timestamp in milliseconds, UTC, when the click was received, whole number), page (site path such as /home or /pricing), dwell_s (seconds on the page, one decimal; about 8% empty).

task_text: Round each click time given in epoch_s down to the start of its minute. `result` should be a table with the columns click_ref (written as in the file, seven digits with leading zeros) and minute_start (the rounded time as a Unix timestamp in seconds), in file order.
intended_computation: Keep click_ref as text; for each of the 500 clicks compute epoch_s rounded down to a multiple of 60 seconds and return click_ref and minute_start in file order (values in April-July 2025, 1743465600-1754006400).

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x the date-time made from seconds keeps a coarser unit, so the integer cast divided by 10**9 is wrong

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
